description: This file defines the InventoryPDFController class responsible for generating PDF documents for inventory records in vtiger CRM. It includes methods for loading records, building different sections of the PDF (header, footer, content, layout), and handling the output of the PDF using other viewer and model classes.

classes.name: Vtiger_InventoryPDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for creating and managing PDF generation for inventory records, including constructing various sections and handling output.

methods.name: loadRecord
methods.description: Loads a record by its ID and initializes the focus object with entity details.

methods.name: getPDFGenerator
methods.description: Returns an instance of the PDF generator.

methods.name: getContentViewer
methods.description: Creates and configures the content viewer based on the Inventory's tax type.

methods.name: getHeaderViewer
methods.description: Creates and configures the header view for the PDF.

methods.name: getFooterViewer
methods.description: Creates and configures the footer view for the PDF.

methods.name: getPagerViewer
methods.description: Creates and configures the pager view for the PDF.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Generates the PDF document and outputs it, given filename and type.
